agent_description: Pinned-font plain text with an explicit intrinsic viewport and deterministic layout contract; this profile defines semantics and does not permit HTML/CSS, system fonts, locale inference or fallback.
excluded_responsibilities: This T0 descriptor does not select or attest a GSUB/GPOS algorithm or software dependency; a T2 shape-provider profile and pinned dependency digest must close that boundary before a backend offers this capability. Automatic wrapping, bidi inference or mixed-direction runs, Unicode normalization, font fallback, TTC/OTC, WOFF/WOFF2, CFF/CFF2, variable fonts, color fonts, SVG glyphs, hinting, LCD/subpixel rendering, host DPI, rich text, HTML/CSS and text transitions are outside this profile.
failure_semantics: Invalid UTF-8, unsupported or mixed scripts, forbidden controls/format characters, every Unicode 17.0.0 Default_Ignorable_Code_Point value, missing glyphs, missing or mismatched font bindings, unsupported font tables/containers, malformed outlines, resource overflow, cancellation and any profile/hash/scope mismatch fail closed without a partial layout, surface or artifact.
keyframe_semantics: Evaluate offsets in clip-local time; clamp before the first keyframe to its value and at/after the last to its value. Hold returns the left value on each half-open keyframe interval. Linear interpolation of scalar, point and rect values uses exact rational progress and exact per-component rational lerp. For cubic-bezier, first compare exact x at the maximum interior Q0.32 point k=2^32-1; if x
layout_input_hash_semantics: Hash a canonical envelope containing text, font size, line height, viewport, language, script, direction, alignment, pinned font content hash, evaluator/font/run/layout/outline/raster/coverage profiles, and the frozen Unicode version/table identity. Exclude fill, paint, FontAssetID, font URI and font metadata. It is suitable for grouping equal fill-independent inputs but is not by itself a final shaped-glyph or coverage-mask cache key; a provider must also bind its versioned shaping algorithm/dependency receipt and concrete outline/raster receipts.
run_input_semantics: Split only at U+000A and create one horizontal run-input buffer per line. Seed clusters with byte offsets into the original complete UTF-8 string, set explicit script/language/direction and BOT|EOT on every line, and require MONOTONE_CHARACTERS cluster level. Variation coordinates, ppem/device scale and caller feature overrides are empty. GuessSegmentProperties, process locale, bidi inference and font fallback are forbidden. This is a Document-level input contract, not a GSUB/GPOS algorithm: a backend may offer the Text v2 capability only with a separately versioned shape-provider profile and pinned implementation/dependency digest.
semantic_hash_semantics: Hash a canonical envelope containing the complete TextSource (including FontAssetID and fill), pinned font content hash, evaluator/font/run/layout/outline/raster/paint/coverage/layout-input profiles, and the frozen Unicode version/table identity. Font URI, font metadata and unrelated Asset members are excluded.
unicode_validation_provenance: Checked-in range tables generated from Unicode 17.0.0 Script properties, General_Category Cc/Cf, variation-selector ranges, and DerivedCoreProperties Default_Ignorable_Code_Point; production validation uses only these frozen tables and never the Go toolchain's mutable Unicode tables.
value_semantics: Consume the exact UTF-8 bytes without Unicode normalization under the declared run-input contract. Font size is the em-square size in viewport pixels. Font-space glyph advances, offsets and glyf outlines are signed y-up Q26.6 values; scale each complete exact font-unit value by fontSize/unitsPerEm and round once to Q26.6 pixels using nearest-even. This horizontal profile requires shaped YAdvance=0 for every glyph; XAdvance supplies the signed pen advance. The first top-down baseline is nearest-even(hhea.ascender*fontSize/unitsPerEm*64); line i is computed directly as nearest-even((hhea.ascender*fontSize/unitsPerEm+i*line_height)*64), never by accumulating rounded baselines. For one line let signed total X advance be A: ltr requires A>=0, rtl requires A<=0, and the alignment advance box is [min(0,A),max(0,A)]. Logical start places that box at the left viewport edge for ltr and right edge for rtl; logical end does the opposite; center places it at the physical center. Negative bearings, glyph offsets and ink bounds never affect alignment. For each glyph before advancing the pen, map viewportX=alignedPenX+scaledXOffset+scaledOutlineX and viewportY=baselineY-scaledYOffset-scaledOutlineY, so positive shaped YOffset moves ink upward; then add the signed scaled XAdvance to the pen. Lines are never automatically wrapped. Rasterize monochrome static TrueType glyf outlines into the declared top-down square-pixel viewport, clip all coverage to it, and apply the evaluator-selected fill exactly once through cutly.color.rgba16-srgb-straight-paint-to-linear-bt709-premultiplied-rgba16.v1 after coverage. The source is immutable at every mapped source time: SourceRange preserves edit identity but never requests retime or transition handles.
